newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Sigma started with buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Sigma started with buy.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said on Monday it has started coverage of Mexican food processing company Sigma Alimentos SA de CV with a buy recommendation.
--"We consider that the share is attractively priced," analysts Urban A.F. Larson and Laura Meizier wrote in a report. "Our 12-month target price is 150 pesos, which allows for a 28 percent upside."
--The analysts said Sigma is Mexico's largest processed meats producer, holding 40 percent of the market share. The company also is working to build its market in dairy products, they said.
--"The consumer recovery in Mexico should lead to accelerated growth in per capita consumption of processed meats and dairy products," Salomon Brothers said.
--The analysts predicted operating income would increase by 20 percent in real terms in both 1997 and 1998.
